user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry assessment and explicitly simulated instruction walkthroughs; not independent agent execution, human research or real customer results. Executed regex fixture is identified separately.

scenarios.request: Use prompt-craft: create a short launch-post prompt for an offline notes app exporting Markdown; calm voice, invite a try, no customer numbers or brand file.
scenarios.expected: Return reusable prompt and verification, generic mode, no fabricated marketing facts.
scenarios.observed: After walkthrough: downstream prompt preserves offline, Markdown, short, calm, invitation and no customer numbers. Verification maps all specifics; added proof boundary disclosed. No named customer, savings, URL or company imported from knowledge examples.

scenarios.request: Use the usual format; there is no brand file; only knowledge examples name fictional venues.
scenarios.observed: Before README example resolved unnamed venues and format from absent context. After: label proposed plain post format as assumption; omit unnamed venues and block fictional proof. Recovery is real context or verified sources, not guessed brand identity.

scenarios.request: A five-month-old brand file contains stable calm voice and a quarterly launch target.
scenarios.expected: Use stable voice only; time-scoped claim stays excluded.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough uses calm voice and emits stale-context notice; quarterly target not copied. Later direct request to write the post exits the prompt task and follows normal work.

similar_skills.learned: Require real claims and lived product details; do not invent results when a voice guide is missing.
similar_skills.reason: Put evidence boundary at the prompt translation step and give a generic no-proof example; keep existing nonblocking generic mode instead of importing a mandatory interview.

similar_skills.learned: Preserve intent and language, use no edit for already clear input, and disclose assumptions.
similar_skills.reason: Retain minimal intervention; reject persistent silent rewrite mode and host-model assumptions because this product returns an explicitly requested reusable prompt.

validation.observed: Executed page and product metadata audit returned VERDICT: PASS.

decision: Changed: enforce source-vs-example boundary in advice and translation, replace unsupported public fixture, align source direct install and sibling URL. Product title/description/topics retained after review.
